description: Réseau urbain Azalys is a dataset listed in transport.data.gouv.fr, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by JVMALIN. The portal lists 4 resources (SIRI, gtfs-rt, GTFS) and files the dataset under the type "public-transit". The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-france-transport-data-gouv-national-access-point.
